data.deterministic_order: sort eligible source stories by SHA256(UTF8('TTM_SIX_G1_V1|'+str(source_row_index)+'|'+sha256(NFC_story_UTF8))) ascending, then first 128 TRAIN, next 64 DEV, next 64 TEST
data.eligibility: first sentence-final punctuation boundary in normalized source text at unicode-codepoint offset [80,192]; otherwise first whitespace boundary from >=128 through 192; require at least 12 nonwhite chars; both Qwen tokenizations 8..96 tokens; else exclude and record why; no manual replacement
data.normalization: Unicode NFC; CRLF/CR -> LF; leading/trailing whitespace strip; replace LF with single ASCII space; do not casefold
data.near_duplicate_policy: group by canonical normalized story SHA; require zero exact overlap; source-wide near-dup guarantee not claimed

probe_bank.scoring: for each model independently use tokenized prefix plus separately-tokenized continuation (no BPE boundary merge); sum causal continuation log-probabilities / positive UTF8 byte length; score A minus B; no chat template; add_special_tokens=False; no generation, no TEST-based tuning

alignment.primary: train-only z-score per feature (epsilon 1e-6); multioutput ridge dual from source 1024 to target 2048; intercept via TRAIN centering; score decomposition target state to 8D teacher target functional responses with second TRAIN-only ridge; no finetuning Qwen
alignment.lambda_selection: DEV macro functional R2; ties choose larger lambda; no TEST selection
alignment.positive_control: target hidden state to target response ridge
alignment.ordinary_baseline: direct source hidden state to target response ridge same lambda grid and DEV selection
negative_controls: TRAIN shuffled source-target pair mapping 1000 fixed permutations
random orthogonal projection with dimensions matched
alignment.geometry: linear centered CKA of primary layer hidden states on heldout paired rows vs 1000 shuffled pairings; retrieval@1 on target hidden nearest aligned source, leave duplicate stories excluded
alignment.data_usage: TRAIN fit only; DEV select alpha; TEST untouched until every file, SHA, estimator, hypothesis and budget reviewed
alignment.null_fairness: Each shuffled-fit negative control uses the same alpha grid and DEV-only selection as the aligned estimator. Frozen permutations of TRAIN pairing only. TEST features and target responses do not affect model or hyperparameter selection.

stats.primary: macro across 8 functions R2=1-SSE/SST, SST relative to TRAIN mean on heldout G1 TEST; source-aligned R2 compared with 1000 shuffled-fit null, ordinary direct ridge and TRAIN mean
stats.effect: observed aligned R2 - empirical 95th percentile of 1000 shuffled-fit null R2 scores on frozen TEST
stats.failed_science_inference: FAIL only if positive control qualified and all gates valid and primary threshold not met; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE_UNDERPOWERED_OR_CONTROL_FAIL
stats.multiplicity_note: functional+geometry co-required conjunction, p <=0.01 each; probe-level effects exploratory only; cannot generalize from 64 TEST stories as universal functional invariance
stats.bootstrap_effect: per-story paired bootstrap 2000 resamples for Delta_R2_aligned_minus_TRAIN_mean on TEST; use identical story indices for aligned and mean; null percentile is calculated once from frozen permuted TRAIN fits, not recomputed inside each bootstrap
stats.sample_size_power_model: NOT_QUALIFIED: 64 TEST story clusters for scoped feasibility; no blanket >=80pct power claim; absence of evidence => INCONCLUSIVE not proof of zero transfer
stats.macro_r2_exact: For each of 8 probes R2_j=1-Σ_{test stories}(rhat_ij-r_ij)^2 / Σ_{test stories}(r_ij-mu_train_j)^2, using TRAIN-only mu and std; macro_R2=(1/8)Σ_j R2_j. Never drop dimensions posthoc.
stats.train_function_std_gate: Compute population std (ddof=0) for 8 raw target-teacher functional scores on TRAIN before TEST read; if any std<1e-5, STOP_INCONCLUSIVE_CONTROL_DEGENERATE before TEST; do not drop/tune probes
stats.test_sst_gate: On one-shot TEST after science lock, if any per-dimension SST<1e-8, verdict INCONCLUSIVE_DEGENERATE_TEST; do not exclude dimension or rerun
stats.feature_scaling: TRAIN-only feature mean and std; apply max(std,1e-6) denominator; target response std must independently clear train_function_std_gate
stats.unknown_teacher_pretraining_overlap: TTM TRAIN-only TEST is held out from G1 mapping fits; not guaranteed unseen by pretrained Qwen
